title: Deslop
description: The live LSP + MCP duplicate-code server for AI coding agents. Deslop streams real-time clone signals to Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Continue, and Codex as code is written — find-similar prevents the copy-paste before it lands. Install via the VS Code VSIX (bundles LSP, MCP server, and CLI); JetBrains plugin in active development.
author: Christian Findlay
